description:
Fair Deal Property Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales,

Are delighted to present to you for sale this pitch-perfect four-bedroom bungalow residence, presented in outstanding condition, occupying a spacious and beautifully maintained site complete with a substantial triple-bay garage, fully equipped workshop, additional storage, and ideally located just one mile from the thriving town of Glenamaddy.

This exceptional home has been meticulously cared for throughout, with the attention to detail immediately apparent from the moment you arrive. A perfectly manicured front lawn leads to freshly laid decorative stone that wraps elegantly around the property, while beautifully maintained gardens and mature privacy hedging create an attractive and secluded setting.

There is an abundance of parking to the rear, making this an ideal property for families, hobbyists, or those requiring additional workspace.

Stepping inside, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hall featuring immaculate tiled flooring and freshly painted walls, setting the tone for the high standard of accommodation that lies beyond.

The bright and inviting living room is flooded with natural light and features a beautiful fireplace together with attractive timber flooring, creating a warm and comfortable space for relaxing and entertaining.

To the rear of the property, the generous kitchen and dining area enjoys dual-aspect windows that fills the room with light and offers an excellent range of fitted kitchen units. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a spacious utility room, which is complemented by a convenient guest WC.

The sleeping accommodation comprises four impeccably presented double bedrooms, each featuring modern timber flooring, built-in wardrobes, and an abundance of natural light.

A spacious and beautifully maintained family bathroom completes the accommodation in this exceptionally well-presented home.

Outside, the property continues to impress. A large rear driveway finished with decorative stone provides extensive parking and leads to the impressive triple-bay garage, which incorporates additional storage along with a fully equipped workshop complete with light and power.

The rear gardens are exceptionally private, enclosed by mature hedging and beautifully maintained throughout. A patio and outdoor dining area provide the perfect setting for entertaining or enjoying long summer evenings, while the generous lawn offers ample space for families to enjoy.

If you are searching for an impeccably presented, wonderfully located four-bedroom bungalow that combines exceptional presentation, generous outdoor space, extensive garage facilities, and outstanding value for money, then this superb home is certain to capture your attention.

Call Fair Deal Property today to arrange your viewing, we would be delighted to hear from you and help in any way that we can.
